program.name: Four Movements
program.subject: Strength
program.blurb: One movement pattern a day, four days round: press, pull, squat and hinge.
program.about: Every day trains one way the body moves. Press day pushes, pull day rows and pulls, squat day bends the knees and hinge day the hips, each in straight sets with the helpers that go with it. Four days rotate, so each pattern comes round again every fourth day. Abs finish every session. Level II moves you one weight up and Level III brings harder variations.
